messages.subject: My darling Margaret — finally I have the tickets
messages.body_text:
My dearest Margaret,

I cannot believe the day has nearly come. After six months of these wonderful conversations the thought of finally meeting you in San Francisco brings tears to my eyes. You have been the light through the loneliest months of my life since my Eleanor passed last year.

I have been at the consulate in Accra all week trying to release the inheritance from my late uncle's estate — the lawyers are dragging their feet exactly as I warned you they might. I have $312,000 sitting in escrow that I cannot touch until the certification clears next month.

I went ahead and reserved my ticket from Accra to SFO on May 18th — Delta flight 209. The fare is $2,418. I tried to put it on my American Express but it was declined again because of the temporary fraud hold I told you about. They will not lift it from outside the United States.

My darling — would you be able to wire just $2,400 to my travel agent today so I do not lose the seat? The minute the inheritance clears next month I will repay you ten times over, and we will finally be together. Please send to:

  Western Union
  Recipient: Daniel Okonkwo (my agent in Accra)
  Reference: SULLIVAN/MAY18

Time is so short my love. I love you Margaret. You have made an old soldier believe in love again.

Forever yours,
Robert
